title: ExtractRequest
description: POST /v1/extract body (DESIGN 3.7). There is deliberately no `tier` property: a client-sent tier is an unknown key and is dropped on parse (D25). Unknown keys are dropped, never rejected. The server rejects (422) image_b64 when is_chat is true or image_allowed is false; that cross-field rule lives in the server, not here.

idempotency_key.description: HMAC(install_salt, sha256) : mode(text|img) : prompt_version : schema_version : rerun. Stable across automatic retries; a user Try again increments rerun.

priority.description: Optional; the beta server ignores it (raw/4_rebuttal_scale #5).

anchor_override.description: Set when the user taps the anchor caption (resolve_only).

raw.description: Opaque model output echoed back for mode resolve_only. Content; never log.

counters.description: F8 daily counters piggybacking on the request. Dims are validated server-side against the enums in behavior_event.schema.json $defs.

Counter.description: One count-only metric row. name and dim are token-shaped (no free text).
